_comment: Curated identity for the EC7Edit catalogue. Everything else is generated:
see editor/scripts/generate_catalog.py. Only put here what no input file
can supply -- a friendly name, a search alias, a sentence of advice --
and record where the identity came from in 'evidence'.

C7AmmoPack.description: Standard rounds for the human weapons.
C7AmmoPack.name: Ammo Pack

C7AssaultCannon.description: Four-round burst, very energy-efficient. CD release only.
C7AssaultCannon.name: Alien Assault Cannon

C7BodyArmor.description: Absorbs damage until it is used up.
C7BodyArmor.name: Body Armor

C7DamageField.description: Walk-through trap rod. Visible only under infrared; it hurts on contact.
C7DamageField.name: Energy Rod

C7DamageFieldAlt.description: Walk-through trap ring. Visible only under infrared; it hurts on contact.
C7DamageFieldAlt.name: Energy Ring

C7Disintegrator.description: Boss and emergency weapon with an enormous energy cost.
C7Disintegrator.name: Alien Disintegrator

C7DualBlaster.description: Economical alien sidearm, two energy per shot.
C7DualBlaster.name: Alien Dual Blaster

C7Eitak.description: Primary alien-world guard; accurate in groups. Use open space.
C7Eitak.name: Eitak

C7Eniram.description: Invisible until it fires. Needs infrared or the proximity map.
C7Eniram.name: Eniram

C7EniramBoss.description: Solid and non-cloaking, carries a Plasma Rifle. Avoid narrow corridors.
C7EniramBoss.name: Eniram Boss

C7FloorPlan.description: Reveals the floor's map. Per-floor, like the access cards.
C7FloorPlan.name: Floor Plan

C7Invulnerability.description: Temporary invulnerability, with the strobing palette.
C7Invulnerability.name: Invulnerability Sphere

C7M343.description: Three-round burst; the preferred human weapon at distance.
C7M343.name: M-343 Tribarrel

C7Mechanoid.description: Slow, audible footsteps, brutal at close range. May drop the Dual Blaster.
C7Mechanoid.name: Mechanoid Warrior

C7MinePack.description: Fifteen-foot blast, lethal to the Marine too. Twenty-five carried at most.
C7MinePack.name: Proximity Mines

C7MorphBarrel.description: A Bandor disguised as a barrel. It morphs when disturbed, and others nearby may rush the kill site.
C7MorphBarrel.evidence: statics/monsters inheritance from C7Bandor; strategy compendium
C7MorphBarrel.name: Bandor (barrel)

C7MorphChair.description: A Bandor disguised as a chair. It morphs when disturbed, and others nearby may rush the kill site.
C7MorphChair.evidence: statics/monsters inheritance from C7Bandor; strategy compendium
C7MorphChair.name: Bandor (chair)

C7MorphFile.description: A Bandor disguised as a filing cabinet. It morphs when disturbed, and others nearby may rush the kill site.
C7MorphFile.evidence: statics/monsters inheritance from C7Bandor; strategy compendium
C7MorphFile.name: Bandor (filing cabinet)

C7MorphPlant.description: A Bandor disguised as a plant. It morphs when disturbed, and others nearby may rush the kill site.
C7MorphPlant.evidence: statics/monsters inheritance from C7Bandor; strategy compendium
C7MorphPlant.name: Bandor (plant)

C7Nerraw.description: Small and apparently harmless; can kill a strong Marine in seconds.
C7Nerraw.name: Nerraw

C7OrganicEye.description: Slow alarm unit, dangerous in packs. Clear it early before it draws traffic.
C7OrganicEye.name: Alioprobe

C7Otrebor.description: Solitary blaster sub-boss with an evil laugh. Burst it down from range.
C7Otrebor.name: Otrebor

C7PlasmaRifle.description: Travelling plasma with a blast radius; it can set off mines.
C7PlasmaRifle.name: Alien Plasma Rifle

C7ProbeEye.description: Extremely fast and sound-reactive, sometimes ambush placed.
C7ProbeEye.name: Animated Probe

C7Rodex.description: Pack attacker that may retreat or turn away. Distinctive squeal.
C7Rodex.name: Rodex

C7Semaj.description: Purple slime that attacks the legs. No ranged weapon, easy to overlook.
C7Semaj.name: Semaj

C7Shotgun.description: Strongest at close range. CD release only.
C7Shotgun.name: Assault Shotgun

C7Solrac.description: Leader boss with an eye-energy attack. Apparitions elsewhere are untouchable.
C7Solrac.name: Solrac

C7Static001.description: Opens red-locked doors. Per-floor: it does not survive a floor change.
C7Static001.evidence: lnspec.cpp:366 maps door arg 1 to this class
C7Static001.name: RED access card

C7Static002.description: Opens blue-locked doors. Per-floor: it does not survive a floor change.
C7Static002.evidence: lnspec.cpp:366 maps door arg 2 to this class
C7Static002.name: BLUE access card

C7Tebazile.description: Guardian boss with a five-stage morph: Tebazile, Eniram Boss, Tymok, Solrac, Tebazile.
C7Tebazile.name: Tebazile

C7Tenaj.description: Smart, quick technician; often turns away. May drop charge packs.
C7Tenaj.name: Tenaj

C7TransporterExit.description: The other end of a paired transporter channel.
C7TransporterExit.name: Transporter Exit

C7TransporterField.description: One end of a paired transporter channel.
C7TransporterField.name: Transporter Field

C7Ttocs.description: Slow and durable brute warrior. Keep your distance.
C7Ttocs.name: Ttocs

C7Tymok.description: Fast dodger with a Plasma Rifle. Works alone; keep moving.
C7Tymok.name: Tymok

PatrolPoint.description: Turns a patrolling alien. Without these every patrolling alien walks in its spawn direction until something blocks it and then stands still forever.
PatrolPoint.evidence: xlat things 90 comment: 254 of 288 markers point at another marker
PatrolPoint.name: Patrol turning point

Player1Start.description: Where the Marine begins the floor. Exactly one per single-player map.
Player1Start.name: Player start

0:85.description: Dispenses health after a four-frame wall animation.

0:88.description: The health unit, present directly in two released maps.

0:9.description: Grants the RED access card. No red card is ever on a floor -- a terminal is the only way to get one.
